notes: Split out from Workbook #10 (Sept 30) at Adrian's request Oct 16 so each channel is its own action item. prompt: I am Kevin Doud, owner of KMD Analytical. Help me complete and optimize KMD Analytical's LinkedIn profile. Use the approved brand book, the actual vial and logo artwork, the current service descriptions and verified business facts (KMD Group LLC dba KMD Analytical, 9631 Topanga Canyon Pl, Chatsworth, CA 91311, kmdanalytical.com once confirmed canonical). First search for an existing LinkedIn listing and give me candidate URLs and why they match; do not assume no result means no account. I will open LinkedIn, confirm ownership, and claim, recover or create it. Then draft every field within LinkedIn's current limits: name, categories, description, services, website and contact links, address, hours, photos and call to action where supported. Leave missing facts as questions. Suggest image sizes for the real logo and banner. No invented accreditation, FDA registration, rankings, review counts, turnaround promises or medical claims. Draft three educational posts in approved wording only. Connect the page to Kevin's personal profile as admin and add a second admin from the register. Finish with a paste-ready field checklist, link-test checklist, verification steps, and a one-line status for the profile register: URL, handle, admin, recovery contact, status, evidence, next step (no passwords).
title: Profiles: LinkedIn company page — About, services, banner, and three approved educational posts
